full_prompt_en: A square cartoon illustration is divided into three tall, narrow panels, each filled by a different exaggerated face against a saturated color field. The left strip is hot magenta and purple, with ragged dark brush marks cutting across the upper background. A round-eyed pink-purple creature enters from the lower left, its wide black mouth curving upward beneath a long nose. Only part of its body is visible, cropped by the tight vertical frame. The middle strip glows orange and red. A dark spiky tuft rises above two protruding white eyes, and the central character's enormous open mouth stretches almost from cheek to cheek. Deep purple shadow fills the mouth, while bright pink rims make the grin seem to spring out of the warm ground. The right strip is cool blue with rough navy strokes. A bluish long-nosed figure looks anxiously to the left, showing large square teeth and a pinched brow; its shoulder and hand press into the lower part of the panel. Thick, irregular black outlines and exaggerated curved contours give each face a separate silhouette, while dry, scratchy color strokes animate the backgrounds. Strong contrast between hot left and center colors and the cold right panel sharpens the change of expression. The lighting is graphic rather than naturalistic, with light facial planes set against deep inked recesses and little cast shadow. The overall composition creates a quick comic rhythm from three cropped, elastic faces and their sharply opposed color moods.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形卡通插画分成三条高而窄的画格，每格都有一张夸张面孔和饱和色背景。左条为炽热的品红与紫色，粗乱的深色笔痕横切上方背景。一个眼睛圆睁的粉紫色生物从左下进入，长鼻子下方宽阔的黑嘴向上弯起。紧窄的竖框裁掉了它身体的大部分。中间一条泛着橙红光。深色尖翘发束竖在两只凸出的白眼上方，中央角色巨大的张开嘴巴几乎从一侧脸颊伸到另一侧。深紫阴影填满口腔，亮粉色嘴缘让笑容仿佛从暖色底上弹出。右条为清冷蓝色，带粗糙的海军蓝笔痕。一个蓝色长鼻角色焦虑地望向左方，露出巨大的方牙和紧锁的眉头；它的肩膀和手挤在画格下部。粗而不规则的黑轮廓与夸张弧线让每张脸各有剪影，干涩的刮擦状色笔则激活背景。左侧和中央的热色与右侧冷色强烈对照，使表情变化更加尖锐。照明偏图形化而非写实，浅色面部平面与深墨凹处相对，几乎没有投影。整体构图依靠三张紧裁的弹性面孔及其尖锐对立的色彩情绪，形成快捷的漫画节奏。
style_prompt_en: The cartoon treatment favors elastic proportions, thick uneven black outlines and sharply simplified color masses. Features stretch beyond ordinary anatomy, yet clear silhouettes and large light-dark divisions keep every expression legible. Hot magenta, orange and red can abut cold blue or violet with little neutral transition, so color changes themselves supply the rhythm. Scratchy dry-brush marks, speckling and rough navy shadows give the flat fields a lively printed texture. Highlights sit on broad planes rather than following realistic light physics, while dark recesses provide strong graphic depth. Tight crops and narrow repeating divisions turn individual shapes into a fast, humorous visual sequence.
style_prompt_zh: 这种卡通处理偏爱弹性比例、粗而不匀的黑轮廓和尖锐概括的色块。特征被拉伸到日常比例之外，但清楚剪影和大块明暗分隔让每种表情都易于辨认。炽热品红、橙、红色可与冷蓝或紫色直接相邻，几乎没有中性色过渡，色彩变化本身便提供节奏。刮擦状干笔痕、细点与粗糙海军蓝阴影使平涂色域带有活泼印刷肌理。高光落在宽阔平面上，而不严格服从写实光学；深色凹处带来强烈图形纵深。紧裁和重复的窄分隔，把单个形状变成快捷而幽默的视觉序列。
theme_en: Three narrow panels of wildly expressive cartoon faces
theme_zh: 三条窄画格中表情夸张的卡通面孔
name: John Kricfalusi
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
